rows.name: Knot Quite Dead LIVE at Reno Public Market
rows.evidence: Nov 27 Friday Community Events Live Music: All Knot Quite Dead LIVE at Reno Public Market Reno Public Market 07:00 PM - 10:00 PM on Fri, 27 Nov 2026 Knot Quite Dead is a Reno-based band built on the spirit of the Grateful Dead, but not bound by it. Dead-inspired at the core (the jams, the harmonies, the long strange trip), but that’s just where the knot starts. They weave in Fleetwood Mac, Tom Petty, Pink Floyd, Janis Joplin, Jefferson Airplane, and the classic vinyl that raised them. That’s why they’re Knot Quite Dead, with a K. Psychedelic Americana tied together with rock & roll roots. Born in small Reno bars and built for big dance floors. If you love the Dead but live for the whole era, you’re already one of them. Grab dinner and drinks from our vendors, find a spot, and settle in for a night of good vibes and great tunes. Friday, November 27 7 to 10 PM Reno Public Market Event Link - https://www.renopublicmarket.com/events/knot-quite-dead-live-at-reno-public-market

rows.name: Nevada Dance Company Presents The Nutcracker
rows.evidence: Nov 27 Friday Theater & Dance: Dance Theater & Dance: Plays Kids & Family Nevada Dance Company Presents The Nutcracker Bob Boldrick Theatre $27.25 to $48.2 Child Tickets: Ages 12 & under Every week through Nov 29, 2026. Sunday: 02:00 PM - 04:30 PM Friday: 07:00 PM - 09:30 PM Saturday: 02:00 PM - 04:30 PM Saturday: 07:00 PM - 09:30 PM Step Into the Magic: Nevada Dance Company Brings The Nutcracker to Life This Thanksgiving Weekend Featuring guest artists from Sacramento Ballet, talented local dancers, four spectacular performances, and a special sensory-friendly presentation of Nutcracker Sweets, November 27-29 in Carson City. CARSON CITY, NEVADA — This Thanksgiving weekend, a world of wonder awaits as Nevada Dance Company invites Northern Nevada families to experience the breathtaking magic of The Nutcracker, November 27-29, 2026, at the Bob Boldrick Theatre inside the Carson City Community Center. This year's production brings an exciting addition to the stage, as special guest artists Isabella Velasquez (Sugar Plum Fairy) & Wyatt McConville-McCoy (Cavalier) from Sacramento Ballet join Nevada Dance Company's talented dancers for an unforgettable celebration of the holiday season. From the first notes of Tchaikovsky's unforgettable score to the final curtain call, this enchanting production transports audiences into a world where toys come to life, snowflakes dance, and dreams become extraordinary adventures. Under the artistic direction of Oliver Adams and Erica Chipp-Adams, Nevada Dance Company's The Nutcracker combines beautiful choreography, dazzling costumes, captivating storytelling, and the extraordinary talents of professional and local dancers to create a spectacular theatrical experience for audiences of all ages.
